cn: 基金经理最高学历为硕士且任职天数小于365天的有哪些？
en: Which fund managers have a highest degree of Master and have served for less than 365 days?
sql: select a.name from mf_fundmanagernew as a join mf_personalinfo as b on a.personalcode = b.personalcode where a.managementtime < 365 and b.education = 'Master'

cn: 找到指标周期为"一个月"的基金收益为正的基金数目，按基金性质分组展示
en: Find the number of funds with positive returns in the fund with an index cycle of "one month," and display them grouped by fund nature.
sql: select b.fundnature, count(*) from mf_fundreturnrank as a join mf_fundarchives as b on a.innercode = b.innercode where a.indexcycle = 'one month' and a.fundreturn > 0 group by b.fundnature

cn: 这两年来"北京业勤投资顾问有限公司"买了哪些公司的股份，股东投资金额分别是多少
en: In the past two years, which companies has "Beijing Yeqin Investment Advisory Co., Ltd." bought shares in, and what are the respective shareholder investment amounts?
sql: select secucode, shinvestsum from lc_relatedsh where shname = 'Beijing Yeqin Investment Advisory Co., Ltd.' and strftime('%Y', enddate) > strftime('%Y', DATE('now', '-2 year'));

cn: 600655哪些配股大股东名称的实配股数超过1百万股
en: Which major shareholders' names of 600655 have actual allotments exceeding 1 million shares?
sql: select shname from lc_largeshsubscription where secucode='600655' and actualshares>1000000;

cn: 占冻结质押方持股数比重超过0.5的股东有哪些，列出股东名称和占冻结质押方持股数量比例
en: Which shareholders have a shareholding proportion exceeding 0.5 in the freezing and pledging party? List the shareholder names and the proportion of shares held by the freezing and pledging party.
sql: select fpshname, pctofpledger from lc_sharefp where pctofpledger > 0.5;

cn: 有哪些基金成立以来基准增长幅度超过了200%
en: What funds have had benchmark growth rates exceeding 200% since inception?
sql: select secuabbr from mf_benchmarkgrowthrate where benchgrforsince>200;

cn: 找下两年基金基准增长幅度大于20%的基金
en: Find funds whose benchmark growth rate is greater than 20% for the past two years.
sql: select secuabbr from mf_benchmarkgrowthrate where benchgrfor2year > 20;

cn: A股总股本超过10亿的公司有哪些，按自由流通比重从大到小排序
en: Which companies in A-shares have a total share capital exceeding 1 billion, sorted by free float ratio in descending order?
sql: select chinameabbr from lc_freefloat where totalashare > 1000000000 order by adjfreefloatratio desc

cn: 去年，600000这支股票的投资者中，哪些股东投资金额达到千万级，列出投资者名称
en: Last year, among the investors of this stock 600000, which shareholders' investment amounts reached tens of millions? List the names of investors.
sql: select shname from lc_relatedsh where shinvestsum > 10000000 and secucode ='600000' and strftime('%Y', enddate) = strftime('%Y', DATE('now', '-1 year'));

cn: 给出本日基金基准增长幅度大于0的基金和经理
en: Provide the funds and managers whose benchmark growth rate is greater than 0 today.
sql: select a.secuabbr, b.manager from mf_benchmarkgrowthrate as a join mf_fundarchives as b on a.innercode=b.innercode where a.dailybenchgr>0;

cn: 江苏省，自由流通占比小于50%的公司有哪些?
en: Which companies in Jiangsu Province have a free float ratio of less than 50%?
sql: select b.chinameabbr from lc_stockarchives as a join lc_freefloat as b on a.companycode = b.companycode where b.adjfreefloatratio < 50 and a.state = 'Jiangsu Province'

cn: 找到哪些月度行情数据中，满足市盈率大于100，且市账率小于5的数据
en: Find the monthly market data where the price-to-earnings ratio is greater than 100 and the price-to-book ratio is less than 5.
sql: select * from qt_monthdata where pb < 5 and pettm > 100;

cn: 帮忙查一下，2020年流通的A股超过50亿的公司数目，按公司所在一级行业分组统计
en: Please help me check the number of companies with a market capitalization exceeding 5 billion yuan in circulation in the A-share market in 2020, grouped by their primary industry.
sql: select a.firstindustryname, count(*) from lc_exgindustry as a join lc_freefloat as b on a.companycode = b.companycode where b.afloats > 5000000000 and strftime('%Y', changedate)='2020' group by  a.firstindustryname

cn: 查下基金总管理规模超过100亿的基金经理及其最高学历
en: Find the fund managers and their highest education qualifications whose total fund management scale exceeds 10 billion.
sql: select b.chinesename, b.education from mf_fmscaleanalysisn as a join mf_personalinfo as b on a.personalcode=b.personalcode where a.totalfundnv > 100;

cn: 2018年，哪些公司的销售毛利率超过了1，列出这些公司代码
en: In 2018, which companies had sales gross profit rates exceeding 1? List the codes of these companies.
sql: select secucode from lc_mainoperincome where grossprofit > 1 and strftime('%Y', enddate)='2018';

cn: 去年营业收入超过1亿元的公司有几个
en: How many companies had operating income exceeding 100 million yuan last year?
sql: select count(*) from lc_mainoperincome where strftime('%Y', enddate) = strftime('%Y', DATE('now', '-1 year')) and mainoperincome > 100000000;

cn: 在任基金数超过5只的基金经理人数，按基金经理最高学历分组统计
en: Number of fund managers serving more than 5 funds, grouped by fund managers’ highest educational level.

cn: 列出本月以来基金基准增长幅度大于5%的基金及具体数值

cn: 证券市场为"上海证券交易所"的基金中，同类基金收益率均值大于0的有哪些？
en: Among the funds whose securities market is "Shanghai Stock Exchange", which similar funds have an average return rate greater than 0?
sql: select a.secuabbr from mf_fundreturnrank as a join mf_fundarchives as b on a.innercode = b.innercode where b.secumarket = 'Shanghai Stock Exchange' and a.fundreturnmean > 0

cn: 本周以来基金基准增速为负的基金由低到高的排名
en: Ranking of funds with negative benchmark growth rates from low to high since the beginning of this week
sql: select secuabbr from mf_benchmarkgrowthrate where benchgrforthisweek<0 order by benchgrforthisweek asc limit 10;

cn: 在股票月度行情中找到流通A股低于100万的数据
en: Find the data of freely tradable A-shares below 1 million in monthly stock market.
sql: select * from qt_monthdata where floatshare < 1000000;

cn: 请问有哪些公司和成交日对应成交金额超过10亿
en: Which companies and corresponding transaction dates have a transaction amount exceeding 1 billion?
sql: select chinameabbr, tradingday from qt_dailyquote where turnovervalue > 1000000000;

cn: 运营成本超过1亿元的公司有哪些，列出股票名称
en: Which companies have operating costs exceeding 100 million yuan? List the names of the stocks.
sql: select chinameabbr from lc_mainoperincome where mainopercost > 100000000;

cn: 返回出让后持股状况超过0.5的公司名称及所属一级行业
en: Return the names of companies and their corresponding primary industries where the post-transfer shareholding exceeds 0.5.
sql: select a.chinameabbr, b.firstindustryname from lc_sharetransfer as a join lc_exgindustry as b on a.companycode = b.companycode where a.pctaftertran > 0.5

cn: 一周基金基准增速高于2%的基金和具体增长率
en: What are the funds whose weekly benchmark growth rate is higher than 2% and their specific growth rate?
sql: select secuabbr, weeklybenchgr from mf_benchmarkgrowthrate where weeklybenchgr>2;

cn: 哪些基金经理的从业年数超过20年，而且最高学历为硕士
en: Which fund managers have worked for more than 20 years and have a highest degree of master's?
sql: select chinesename from mf_personalinfo where experiencetime > 20 and education = 'Master's';

cn: 列出600256的实配股数超过1百万股的股东名称
en: List the names of shareholders with an actual allocation of more than one million shares for 600256.
sql: select shname from lc_largeshsubscription where secucode='600256' and actualshares>1000000;

cn: 哪些经理的本日基金基准增长率大于0
en: Which managers have a daily fund benchmark growth rate greater than 0?
sql: select b.manager from mf_benchmarkgrowthrate as a join mf_fundarchives as b on a.innercode=b.innercode where a.dailybenchgr>0;

cn: 注册资本超过100亿的基金管理人简称
en: The abbreviations of fund managers with registered capital exceeding 10 billion.
sql: select investadvisorabbrname from mf_investadvisoroutline where regcapital > 10000000000;

cn: 证券代码50开头的且基金经理任职天数超过365天的基金经理姓名
en: What is the name of the fund manager whose security code starts with 50 and has been in office for more than 365 days?
sql: select name from mf_fundmanagernew where secucode like '50%' and managementtime > 365

cn: 这两年，作为质押方，中国进出口银行管理了几家公司的冻结质押股份
en: In the past two years, how many companies has China Eximbank managed frozen pledge shares for as the pledgor?
sql: select count(*) from lc_sharefp where receivername='China Eximbank' and strftime('%Y', enddate) > strftime('%Y', DATE('now', '-2 year'));

cn: 找到浙江省流通的A股超过1亿的公司有多少家
en: How many companies in Zhejiang Province have circulating A-shares exceeding 100 million?
sql: select count(*) from lc_stockarchives as a join lc_freefloat as b on a.companycode = b.companycode where a.state = 'Zhejiang Province' and b.afloats > 100000000

cn: 本日基金基准增长幅度为负的基金及经理
en: Which funds and managers have a negative daily benchmark growth rate today?
sql: select a.secuabbr, b.manager from mf_benchmarkgrowthrate as a join mf_fundarchives as b on a.innercode=b.innercode where a.dailybenchgr<0;

cn: 有经理的本日基金基准增长率为正吗
en: Is the benchmark growth rate of funds with managers positive today?
sql: select b.manager from mf_benchmarkgrowthrate as a join mf_fundarchives as b on a.innercode=b.innercode where a.dailybenchgr>0;

cn: 五年基金基准增速超过了50%的基金代码
en: What are the fund codes whose benchmark growth rate for the past five years exceeded 50%?
sql: select secucode from mf_benchmarkgrowthrate where benchgrfor5year>50;

cn: 经理管理的基金本季度以来基金基准增长率为正的个数由高到低排名
en: The ranking of the number of funds managed by managers with positive benchmark growth rates from high to low since this quarter.
sql: select b.manager, count(*) from mf_benchmarkgrowthrate as a join mf_fundarchives as b on a.innercode=b.innercode where a.benchgrforthisquarter > 0 group by b.manager order by count(*) desc;

cn: 我想知道2020年以前，哪些公司的成本不超过1千万
en: I want to know which companies had a cost of less than 10 million before 2020.
sql: select  secucode from lc_mainoperincome  where mainopercost <= 10000000 and strftime('%Y', enddate)<'2020';

cn: 深圳市自由流通股本超过1000万的公司名称及董事长秘书
en: What are the names of the companies in Shenzhen with a free float of more than 10 million and their Chairman's secretary?
sql: select b.chinameabbr, a.secretarybd from lc_stockarchives as a join lc_freefloat as b on a.companycode = b.companycode where b.adjfreefloats > 10000000 and a.city = 'Shenzhen'

cn: 看下本周以来基金基准增长率为正的经理
en: Look at the managers whose fund benchmark growth rate has been positive since this week.
sql: select b.manager from mf_benchmarkgrowthrate as a join mf_fundarchives as b on a.innercode=b.innercode where a.benchgrforthisweek>0;

cn: 看下谁管理的股票型基金数目超过10个
en: Take a look at who manages more than 10 equity funds.
sql: select chinesename from mf_fmscaleanalysisn where equityfundn>10;

cn: 能帮我查一下山东海化这两年的营业总成本和毛利数据吗
en: Can you help me look up the total operating cost and gross profit data for Shandong Haihua in the past two years?
sql: select mainopercost, grossprofit from lc_mainoperincome where strftime('%Y', enddate) > strftime('%Y', DATE('now', '-2 year')) and chinameabbr = 'Shandong Haihua';

cn: 证券从业年数超过20的基金经理最高学历分布情况
en: What is the distribution of the highest education level among fund managers with more than 20 years of securities industry experience?
sql: select education, count(*) from mf_personalinfo where experiencetime > 20 group by education;

cn: 看下本月以来基金基准增长幅度为正的基金和经理
en: Look at funds and managers whose benchmark growth rate has been positive since the beginning of this month.
sql: select b.secuabbr, b.manager from mf_benchmarkgrowthrate as a join mf_fundarchives as b on a.innercode=b.innercode where a.benchgrforthismonth > 0;

cn: 最大盈利超过2的基金经理姓名和简介
en: What are the names and introductions of fund managers whose maximum profit exceeds 2?
sql: select a.chinesename, b.background from mf_fmperfanalysis as a join mf_personalinfo as b on a.personalcode = b.personalcode where a.maxret > 2

cn: 已流通A股占A股总数比重超过30%的公司公司名称及所在省份
en: The company names and provinces where the companies with a proportion of circulating A-shares exceeding 30% are located?
sql: select a.chinameabbr, b.state from lc_sharesfloatingschedule as a join lc_stockarchives as b on a.companycode = b.companycode where a.proportion2 > 30;

cn: 搜搜看送股占比超过0.5的上市公司是哪些，列出上市公司股票代码和股票名称
en: Which listed companies have a bonus share ratio exceeding 0.5? List the stock codes and names of the listed companies.
sql: select secucode, chinameabbr from lc_dividend where bonusshareratio > 0.5;

cn: 最近两年收入不足1千万的公司有哪些，列出股票代码
en: Which companies have had income of less than 10 million in the past two years? List the stock codes.
sql: select secucode from lc_mainoperincome where strftime('%Y', enddate) > strftime('%Y', DATE('now', '-2 year')) and mainoperincome < 10000000;

cn: 麻烦查询一下2020年以前，600673的营业收入同比增长幅度有为负数的的记录，展示营业收入同比增长幅度字段即可
en: Please query the records before 2020 where the YoY growth rate of operating income for 600673 is negative, and display the field of YoY growth rate of operating income.
sql: select mainincomegrowrateyoy from lc_mainoperincome where mainincomegrowrateyoy < 0 and strftime('%Y', enddate)<'2020' and secucode ='600673';

cn: 有几只股票出现过市账率低于1的情况
en: How many stocks have had a price-to-book ratio of less than 1?
sql: select count(distinct chinameabbr) from qt_monthdata where pb < 1;

cn: 请问股票300770有几个交易日成交额超5亿元
en: How many trading days does stock 300770 have with turnover value exceeding 500 million yuan?
sql: select count(tradingday) from qt_dailyquote where secucode = '300770' and turnovervalue > 500000000;

cn: 户均持股比例半年增速超过15%的公司
en: Companies with half-year growth rate of average shareholder holdings exceeding 15%
sql: select chinameabbr from lc_shnumber where proportiongrhalfayear>15;

cn: 统计一下持股占比超过0.2的公司有多少家
en: How many companies have a shareholding percentage exceeding 0.2?
sql: select count(*) from lc_sharetransfer where pctbeforetran > 0.2

cn: 已流通A股占A股总数比重超过60%的公司有多少家，按一级行业分组展示
en: How many companies have circulating A shares that account for more than 60% of the total A shares, grouped by primary industry?
sql: select b.firstindustryname, count(*) from lc_sharesfloatingschedule as a join lc_exgindustry as b on a.companycode = b.companycode where a.proportion2 > 60 group by b.firstindustryname

cn: 已流通A股占A股总数比重超过50%的公司共有多少家，按所在省份分组展示
en: What is the total number of companies whose proportion of circulating A shares exceeds 50%, grouped by province?
sql: select b.state, count(*) from lc_sharesfloatingschedule as a join lc_stockarchives as b on a.companycode = b.companycode where a.proportion2 > 50 group by b.state

cn: 流通A股超过500万，按自由流通比重从大到小排序，排名前100的公司有哪些
en: Which are the companies that are ranked in the top 100 by the ratio of free float of the circulating A-shares, sorted from the highest to the lowest, with a free float of over 5 million?
sql: select chinameabbr from lc_freefloat where afloats > 5000000 order by adjfreefloatratio desc limit 100

cn: 哪些经理的基金成立以来基准增速超过100%的，具体值都是多少？
en: Which managers' funds have benchmark growth rates exceeding 100% since inception and what are the specific values?
sql: select b.manager, a.benchgrforsince from mf_benchmarkgrowthrate as a join mf_fundarchives as b on a.innercode=b.innercode where a.benchgrforsince>100;

cn: 筛选出那些管理股票型基金数目超过0的基金经理，并附加查询管理的股票型基金数目
en: Select fund managers whose number of managed equity funds exceeds 0 and include the query of the number of managed equity funds.
sql: select chinesename, equityfundn from mf_fmscaleanalysisn where equityfundn > 0;

cn: 帮我看看历史上利润贡献率大于1的公司有多少
en: How many companies in history have a profit contribution rate greater than 1?
sql: select count(*) from lc_mainoperincome where grossprofit >1;

cn: 显示流通A股超过10亿和股票代码以60开头公司名称及所属一级行业
en: Display the company name and first-level industry of companies with a market capitalization of over 1 billion yuan and whose stock codes start with "60".
sql: select a.chinameabbr, b.firstindustryname from lc_sharestru as a join lc_exgindustry as b on a.companycode = b.companycode where a.afloats > 1000000000 and a.secucode like '60%'

cn: 嗨，能查一下最近两年，"华安石油A"的开放式基金单位基金净值日增长幅度吗
en: Hi, can you check the daily growth rate of the unit net value for "Huaxia Oil A" in the open-ended fund in the past two years?
sql: select enddate, nvdailygrowthrate from mf_netvalue where strftime('%Y', enddate) > strftime('%Y', DATE('now', '-2 year')) and secuabbr ='Huaxia Oil A';

cn: 哪些投资者买了浦发银行的股票，并且股东投资金额超过1千万
en: Which investors bought shares of Shanghai Pudong Development Bank and had shareholder investment exceeding 10 million?
sql: select shname from lc_relatedsh where shinvestsum > 10000000 and chinameabbr ='Shanghai Pudong Development Bank';

cn: 相对上一期报告期户均持股占比变化大于20%的公司
en: Companies with a change in the average proportion of shareholding greater than 20% compared to the previous reporting period
sql: select chinameabbr from lc_shnumber where proportionchange>20;

cn: 基金净值增长率小于0.1的基金经理名称及最高学历
en: What are the names of fund managers and their highest education level for funds with a net growth rate less than 0.1?
sql: select a.name, b.education from mf_fundmanagernew as a join mf_personalinfo as b on a.personalcode = b.personalcode where a.performance < 0.1

cn: 去年浙江省内成本超过1000亿元的公司有哪些
en: Which companies in Zhejiang Province had a main operating cost of over 100 billion yuan last year?
sql: select a.chinameabbr from lc_mainoperincome as a join lc_stockarchives as b on a.companycode = b.companycode where a.mainopercost > 100000000000 and b.state ='Zhejiang Province' and strftime('%Y', a.enddate) = strftime('%Y', DATE('now', '-1 year'));

cn: 去年浙江省内营收超过1000亿元的公司有哪些
en: Which companies in Zhejiang province had revenues exceeding 100 billion yuan last year?
sql: select a.chinameabbr from lc_mainoperincome as a join lc_stockarchives as b on a.companycode = b.companycode where strftime('%Y', a.enddate) = strftime('%Y', DATE('now', '-1 year')) and b.state='Zhejiang province' and a.mainoperincome > 100000000000;

cn: 最大回撤超过0.5的基金经理姓名和最高学历
en: What are the names of fund managers and their highest education qualification with a maximum drawdown exceeding 0.5?
sql: select a.chinesename, b.education from mf_fmperfanalysis as a join mf_personalinfo as b on a.personalcode = b.personalcode where a.maxdd > 0.5

cn: 请问有哪些公司户均持股占比季度增速超过10%
en: Which companies have quarterly growth rates of average shareholding proportion exceeding 10%?
sql: select chinameabbr from lc_shnumber where proportiongrquarter>10;

cn: 找出一个月基金基准增长幅度为正的基金和基金经理
en: Find the funds and fund managers with positive benchmark growth rate in one month.
sql: select b.secuabbr, b.manager from mf_benchmarkgrowthrate as a join mf_fundarchives as b on a.innercode=b.innercode where a.monthlybenchgr>0;

cn: 列出2020年以来东软集团每月收盘价，PE和市净率PB的走势
en: List the monthly closing price, PE ratio, and PB ratio of Dongsoft Group since 2020.
sql: select closeprice, pettm, pb from qt_monthdata where chinameabbr = 'Dongsoft Group' and strftime('%Y', enddate) >= '2020';

cn: 营业收入超过1000亿元的公司都分布在哪些省份
en: In which provinces are the companies with a business income of over 100 billion yuan distributed?
sql: select b.state from lc_mainoperincome as a join lc_stockarchives as b on a.companycode = b.companycode where a.mainoperincome > 100000000000;

cn: 可流通开始日位于2020年以后的公司有哪几家？
en: Which companies have their start date for circulation after 2020?
sql: select count(*) from lc_sharesfloatingschedule where strftime('%Y', startdateforfloating)>'2020'

cn: 600000这支股票的投资者中，有哪些从股东投资额超过了1千万，列出投资者名称和股东投资金额
en: Among the investors of stock 600000, which ones have shareholder investment amount exceeding 10 million? List the investor names and shareholder investment amounts.
sql: select shname, shinvestsum from lc_relatedsh where shinvestsum > 10000000 and secucode ='600000' ;

cn: 计算持股比例超过0.5的公司有多少家
en: How many companies have a shareholding percentage exceeding 0.5?
sql: select count(*) from lc_sharetransfer where pctaftertran > 0.5

cn: 基金总规模超过1000亿元的基金经理人数超过5个的最高学历有哪些？
en: What are the highest educational qualifications of fund managers with a total fund size of over 100 billion RMB and more than 5 individuals?
sql: select b.education from mf_fmretscaleanalysis as a join mf_personalinfo as b on a.personalcode = b.personalcode where a.totalaum > 1000 group by b.education having count(*) > 5

cn: 找到指标周期为"一个月"的基金收益为正的基金数目，按基金投资类型分组展示
en: Find the number of funds with positive returns for the indicator period of "one month", grouped by fund investment type.
sql: select b.investmenttype, count(*) from mf_fundreturnrank as a join mf_fundarchives as b on a.innercode = b.innercode where a.indexcycle = 'one month' and a.fundreturn > 0 group by b.investmenttype

cn: 看下一个月基金基准增速大于7%的基金管理人
en: Look at the fund managers whose fund benchmark growth rate is greater than 7% in the next month.
sql: select b.investadvisorname from mf_benchmarkgrowthrate as a join mf_fundarchives as b on a.innercode=b.innercode where a.monthlybenchgr>7;

cn: 时间区间为"近5年"，基金经理管理的平均规模超过20亿元的人数超过5的基金经理最高学历
en: What is the highest education level of fund managers whose number exceeds 5 and the average size of funds managed by them is over 2 billion yuan in the time interval of "recent 5 years"?
sql: select b.education from mf_fmretscaleanalysis as a join mf_personalinfo as b on a.personalcode = b.personalcode where a.timeinterval = 'recent 5 years' and a.avgaum > 2 group by b.education having count(*) > 5

cn: 山东海化这两年表现咋样，查一下这两年它的主营业支出和利润贡献率
en: How has Shandong Haihua performed in the past two years? Please check its main operating expenses and contribution margin for profit in these two years.
sql: select mainopercost, grossprofit from lc_mainoperincome where strftime('%Y', enddate) > strftime('%Y', DATE('now', '-2 year')) and chinameabbr ='Shandong Haihua';

cn: 基金代码以16开头的，基金收益大于0的基金有多少只
en: How many funds have a fund code starting with 16 and a positive fund return?
sql: select count(*) from mf_fundreturnrank where secucode like '16%' and fundreturn > 0

cn: 列出最高学历为本科且基金净值增长率为负的基金经理有多少位
en: How many fund managers have a bachelor's degree as their highest education level and a negative fund growth rate?
sql: select count(a.name) from mf_fundmanagernew as a join mf_personalinfo as b on a.personalcode = b.personalcode where a.performance < 0 and b.education = 'Bachelor's degree'

cn: 看下本周以来基金基准增速为正的基金和增长率情况
en: Check the funds with positive benchmark growth rate and their growth rate since this week.
sql: select secuabbr, benchgrforthisweek from mf_benchmarkgrowthrate where benchgrforthisweek>0;

cn: 博瑞传播配股股东里实际配股超过1百万股的都有哪些
en: Which shareholders of Borui Communications have actual allotments of more than 1 million shares?

cn: 去年研发投入占营业收入占比大于10%的公司有哪些

cn: 挑选出本周以来基金基准增速为正的基金及经理
en: Select funds and managers with positive benchmark growth rate since this week.

cn: 哪些经理管理的混合型基金数目大于5个，具体数量是多少

sql: select a.secondindustryname from lc_exgindustry as a join lc_freefloat as b on a.companycode = b.companycode where b.afloats > 5000000 group by a.secondindustryname order by count(*) desc limit 1

sql: select secucode from lc_sharefp where involvedsum > 10000000 and strftime('%Y', enddate) = strftime('%Y', DATE('now', '-1 year'));

cn: 2012年以来，"中国证券报"设立的"五年期开放式混合型持续优胜金牛基金"奖项颁给了多少个不同的投资基金
en: Since 2012, how many different investment funds have been awarded the "Five-Year Open-End Hybrid Continuous Outstanding Golden Bull Fund" prize established by "China Securities Journal"?
sql: select count(distinct fund) from mf_awards where strftime('%Y', `year`) >=2012 and awardname ='Five-Year Open-End Hybrid Continuous Outstanding Golden Bull Fund' and appraisalorg ='China Securities Journal';

cn: 可以查一下，哪个城市的有限售条件流通A股股数超过10亿的公司数目超过10家
en: Can you check how many cities have more than 10 companies with restricted circulating A-shares exceeding 1 billion?
sql: select a.city from lc_stockarchives as a join lc_sharestru as b on a.companycode = b.companycode where b.restrictasharep > 1000000000 group by a.city having count(*) > 10

cn: 已流通股数超过1000万股的公司有多少家，按省份分组展示
en: How many companies have a circulating share of more than 10 million shares, grouped by province?

cn: 列出本月以来基金基准增长率大于5%的基金

sql: select province from ed_industryproduction where reportarea = 'province/city' and statstandard = 'All Industrial Enterprises' and reportperiod = 'monthly' and industrialvalueadded > 1000;

sql: select count(*) from ed_financialbalance where gfinancialrevenue >5 and strftime('%Y', enddate)='2000';

en: Hello, please check the fund managers whose annualized return exceeds 0.5 and maximum drawdown is less than 0.2, and list their years of experience and educational level.
sql: select a.chinesename, b.education, b.experiencetime from mf_fmperfanalysis as a join mf_personalinfo as b on a.personalcode = b.personalcode where a.annabnreturn > 0.5 and a.maxdd < 0.2;

en: How many companies have records of stock allocations in the past two years?

cn: 北京市"国有及规模以上工业企业"中，"年度"工业增加值超过10亿的记录有哪些，仅包含时间和工业增加值字段即可

cn: 2020年非自由流通股本小于500万的公司有哪几家？

cn: 各行业中，总股本超过5000万的公司有多少家，按第一行业分组展示

sql: select b.chinameabbr from lc_intassetsdetail as a join lc_stockarchives as b on a.companycode=b.companycode where a.rdstaffnumratio>10 and a.rdinputratio>15 and b.state='Hunan Province';

cn: 查一下流通A股股本超过10亿和公司所属一级行业为"房地产业"的公司有多少家
en: How many companies have circulating A shares exceeding 1 billion and belong to the primary industry of "Real Estate"?
sql: select count(*) from lc_sharestru as a join lc_exgindustry as b on a.companycode = b.companycode where a.afloats > 1000000000 and b.firstindustryname = 'Real Estate'

cn: 前一年配售股票总数超过100万的公司有几家
en: How many companies had more than one million shares allocated in the previous year?
sql: select count(*) from lc_legaldistribution where distributionsum > 1000000 and strftime('%Y', infopubldate) = strftime('%Y', DATE('now', '-1 year'));

cn: 请列出近3年来，咱们每年的外汇金额和货币黄金总值，详细记录从货币当局资产负债表中查找
en: Please list the amount of foreign exchange and the total value of currency and gold in each of the past 3 years. Detailed records are to be found from the balance sheet of the monetary authority.
sql: select enddate, forex, moneyandgold from ed_moneyauthoritybs where strftime('%Y', enddate) > strftime('%Y', DATE('now', '-3 year'));

cn: 列出gdp不足200亿，但是人均GDP超过5000的省份名称，2008年的就行
en: List the names of provinces with GDP below 200 billion but per capita GDP exceeding 5,000 in 2008.
sql: select province from ed_grossdomesticproduct where strftime('%Y', enddate)='2008' and gdp < 200 billion and gdppercapita > 5,000;

cn: 有哪些基金的本周以来基金基准增长率超过5%
en: Which funds have a benchmark growth rate exceeding 5% for the current week?
sql: select secuabbr from mf_benchmarkgrowthrate where benchgrforthisweek>5;

cn: 显示流通A股股本超过10亿和股票代码以60开头公司名称及所属一级行业
en: Display the names of companies with circulating A-share capital exceeding 1 billion and stock codes starting with "60", along with their respective primary industries.
sql: select a.chinameabbr, b.firstindustryname from lc_sharestru as a join lc_exgindustry as b on a.companycode = b.companycode where a.afloats > 1000000000 and a.secucode like '60%'

cn: 占冻结质押方持股数比例超过0.5的股东有哪些，列出股东名称和占冻结质押方持股数量比例
en: Which shareholders have a proportion of shareholding that exceeds 0.5 in frozen pledge, and list their names and the proportion of shareholding to the frozen pledge party.
sql: select fpshname, pctofpledger from lc_sharefp where pctofpledger > 0.5;

cn: 时间区间为"近六个月"而且基金总规模超过100亿元的基金经理姓名和背景介绍
en: What are the names and background introductions of fund managers with a total fund scale exceeding 10 billion yuan in the time interval of "recent six months"?
sql: select a.chinesename, b.background from mf_fmretscaleanalysis as a join mf_personalinfo as b on a.personalcode = b.personalcode where a.totalaum > 10,000,000,000 and a.timeinterval = 'recent six months'

cn: 计算2015年至今总配股次数
en: Calculate the total number of allotment of shares from 2015 till now.
sql: select count(*) from lc_ashareplacement where strftime('%Y', playear)>='2015';

cn: 去年配售股数超过100万的企业有几家
en: How many companies had more than 1 million shares issued in last year's distribution?
sql: select count(*) from lc_legaldistribution where distributionsum > 1000000 and strftime('%Y', infopubldate) = strftime('%Y', DATE('now', '-1 year'));

cn: 601377这支股票这三年来的股东名称和持股数量是多少
en: What are the shareholder names and shareholding quantities of stock code 601377 in the past three years?
sql: select shname, holdingsum from lc_relatedsh where secucode = '601377' and strftime('%Y', enddate) > strftime('%Y', DATE('now', '-3 year'));

cn: 近两年有不少公司配售股票，帮忙列一下满足条件的股票名称和股票代码
en: In the past two years, many companies have conducted private placements. Please list the stock names and stock codes that meet the criteria.
sql: select chinameabbr, secucode from lc_legaldistribution  where strftime('%Y', infopubldate) > strftime('%Y', DATE('now', '-2 year'));

cn: 显示指标周期为"六个月"的同类基金收益率均值为负的基金数目，按基金类别分组展示
en: What is the number of funds with negative average rate of return in the same type of funds, with an index cycle of "six months," displayed and grouped by fund category?
sql: select fundtypename, count(*) from mf_fundreturnrank where indexcycle = 'six months' and fundreturnmean < 0 group by fundtypename

cn: 指标周期为"一年"，年化阿尔法超过0.1的基金经理人数，按基金经理国籍分组展示
en: Display the number of fund managers whose annualized alpha exceeds 0.1, grouped by the nationality of fund managers, with the index cycle set as "one year".
sql: select b.nationality, count(*) from mf_fmperfanalysis as a join mf_personalinfo as b on a.personalcode = b.personalcode where a.annalphacoef > 0.1 and a.indexcycle = 'one year' group by b.nationality

cn: 请提取2010年以来，我们每年的储备资产金额数据，从其他存款性公司资产负债表中
en: Please extract the amount of our reserve assets data each year since 2010 from the balance sheet of other deposit-taking company.
sql: select enddate, reserveassets from ed_otherdepositorycorpbs where strftime('%Y', enddate) >= '2010';

cn: 已流通A股占A股总数比例超过20%的公司都位于哪些行业
en: Which industries are the companies located in where the proportion of circulating A shares exceeds 20% of the total A shares?
sql: select b.firstindustryname from lc_sharesfloatingschedule as a join lc_exgindustry as b on a.companycode = b.companycode where a.proportion2 > 20

cn: "混合型"基金中，设立以来年化回报率达到30%的有哪些
en: What are the funds in the "Mixed" category that have achieved an annualized return rate of 30% or higher since inception?
sql: select a.secuabbr from mf_netvalueperformancehis as a join mf_fundarchives as b on a.innercode = b.innercode and b.fundtype ='Mixed' where a.annualizedrrsincestart > 30;

cn: 哪些基金持有国开1702其超过一百万张
en: Which funds hold more than one million shares of National Development 1702?
sql: select secuabbr from mf_bondportifoliodetail where bondabbr='National Development 1702' and holdvolume>1000000;

cn: 去年，600000这支股票的投资者中，哪些投资金额达到千万级，列出投资者名称
en: Last year, among the investors of the stock 600000, which ones had investment amounts reaching tens of millions? List the names of the investors.
sql: select shname from lc_relatedsh where shinvestsum > 10000000 and secucode = '600000' and strftime('%Y', enddate) = strftime('%Y', DATE('now', '-1 year'));

cn: 找出2000年，我国金融机构信贷收支表中，流通中货币不足1千万元的记录，包含金融债券、有价证券及投资、股权和其他投资
en: Find the records in the 2000 financial institution balance sheet in China where the money in circulation is less than 10 million Yuan, including financial bonds, securities and investments, equities, and other investments.
sql: select financialbonds, equityandotherinvestment, sharesandotherinvestments from ed_chinafibalancesheetrmb where strftime('%Y', enddate)='2000' and moneyincirculation < 10000000;

cn: 国籍为中国，从业年数超过10的基金经理有哪些？他们的年化收益怎么样
en: Which fund managers have Chinese nationality and have more than 10 years of work experience? How is their annualized return?
sql: select b.chinesename, a.annabnreturn from mf_fmperfanalysis as a join mf_personalinfo as b on a.personalcode = b.personalcode where b.nationality = '中国' and b.experiencetime > 10;

cn: 本次新增可售A股占上期末已流通A股比例小于20%有多少家
en: How many companies have a proportion of newly added salable A-shares to the total number of circulating A-shares at the end of the previous period less than 20%?
sql: select count(*) from lc_sharesfloatingschedule where proportion1 < 20

cn: 哪些ETF基金的一个月基金基准增长率大于0
en: Which ETF funds have a one-month fund benchmark growth rate greater than 0?
sql: select b.secuabbr from mf_benchmarkgrowthrate as a join mf_fundarchives as b on a.innercode=b.innercode  where b.type='ETF' and a.monthlybenchgr>0;

cn: 显示总基金规模大于1000亿元的基金经理学历分布情况
en: Show the distribution of fund manager education for funds with total AUM greater than 100 billion yuan.
sql: select b.education, count(*) from mf_fmretscaleanalysis as a join mf_personalinfo as b on a.personalcode = b.personalcode where a.totalaum > 1000 group by b.education

cn: 这十年来上海市的财政收入增速和财政支出增速分别是多少
en: What are the growth rates of Shanghai's fiscal revenue and fiscal expenditure in the past ten years?
sql: select gfinancialrevenue, gfinancialexpenditure from ed_financialbalance  where province ='Shanghai' and strftime('%Y', enddate) > strftime('%Y', DATE('now', '-10 year'));

cn: 听说"晨星资讯"设立的奖项不错，请列出2010年至今，获得过"债券型基金奖提名"的投资基金的名称
en: I heard that the awards established by "Morningstar Information" are good. Please list the names of the investment funds that have been nominated for the "Bond Fund Award" since 2010.
sql: select count(*) from mf_awards where strftime('%Y', `year`) >= 2010 and awardname = 'Bond Fund Award Nomination' and appraisalorg = 'Morningstar Information';

cn: 给出两年基金基准增长率都为正的基金和基金类型
en: Provide the funds and fund types with positive benchmark growth rates for two years.
sql: select b.secuabbr, b.fundtype from mf_benchmarkgrowthrate as a join mf_fundarchives as b on a.innercode=b.innercode where a.benchgrfor2year>0;

cn: 统计一下3年前，深圳特区的"国有及规模以上工业企业"中，大中小型企业的"年度"工业生产总值分别是多少
en: What is the industrial production value of large, medium, and small enterprises in "state-owned and above-scale industrial enterprises" in Shenzhen Special Economic Zone three years ago?
sql: select enddate, largecomap, mediumcomap, minitypecomap from ed_industryproduction where province ='Shenzhen' and statstandard ='state-owned and above-scale industrial enterprises' and reportperiod ='annual' and strftime('%Y', enddate) < strftime('%Y', DATE('now', '-3 year'));

cn: 返回位于广东省的公司，对应的出让前持股数量超过1000万的公司有多少家
en: How many companies in Guangdong Province have a corresponding pre-transfer shareholding quantity exceeding 10 million?
sql: select count(*) from lc_sharetransfer as a join lc_stockarchives as b on a.companycode = b.companycode where b.state = 'Guangdong Province' and a.sumbeforetran > 10000000

cn: 这些年来，在其他存款性公司资产负债表中，总资产金额超过5千万年的记录有哪些，列出时间，总资产金额和总负债金额
en: In recent years, what are the records in the balance sheets of other deposit-taking companies where the total asset amount exceeded 50 million yuan? List the time, total asset amount, and total liability amount.
sql: select enddate, totalassets, totalliabilities from ed_otherdepositorycorpbs where totalassets > 50000000;

cn: 统计下最近两年进行过股份回购的公司，列出公司名称和股票名称
en: Please list the names of companies and stock names that have conducted share repurchases in the past two years.
sql: select chiname, chinameabbr from lc_buyback where strftime('%Y', advancedate) > strftime('%Y', DATE('now', '-2 year'));

cn: 请展示一下设立以来收益率超过50%的基金中，是"股票型"的基金名称和代码
en: Please show the names and codes of funds in the "Stock Fund" category with a return rate exceeding 50% since inception.
sql: select a.secuabbr, a.secucode from mf_netvalueperformancehis as a join mf_fundarchives as b on a.innercode = b.innercode and b.fundtype ='Stock Fund' where a.rrsincestart > 50;

cn: 列出学历为硕士且基金净值增长率为负的基金经理名称
en: List the names of fund managers with a master's degree and a negative fund return rate.
sql: select a.name from mf_fundmanagernew as a join mf_personalinfo as b on a.personalcode = b.personalcode where a.performance < 0 and b.education = 'Master's degree'

cn: 帮我统计下最近两年朝阳科技的投资者数量
en: Help me calculate the number of investors in Chaoyang Technology in the past two years.
sql: select count(*) from lc_legaldistribution where chinameabbr ='Chaoyang Technology' and strftime('%Y', infopubldate) > strftime('%Y', DATE('now', '-2 year'));

cn: 看下本周以来基金基准增长率为正的基金和增长率情况
en: Check the funds with positive benchmark growth rate and their growth rate since the beginning of the week.
sql: select secuabbr, benchgrforthisweek from mf_benchmarkgrowthrate where benchgrforthisweek > 0;

cn: 去年主营业务收入超过1000亿元的公司有多少家
en: How many companies had main operating income exceeding 100 billion yuan last year?
sql: select count(*) from lc_mainoperincome where chinameabbr = 'Sinopec' and strftime('%Y', enddate) = strftime('%Y', DATE('now', '-1 year')) and mainoperincome > 100000000000;

cn: 找到哪些管理债券型基金数量超过2的基金经理，并附加展示管理债券型基金总规模
en: Find the fund managers whose number of managed bond funds exceeds 2, and display the total size of managed bond funds.
sql: select chinesename, bondfundnv from mf_fmscaleanalysisn where bondfundn > 2;

cn: 统计一下设立以来年化收益率超过20%的"债券型"基金的数量
en: What is the number of "bond-type" funds with annualized returns exceeding 20% since establishment?
sql: select count(*) from mf_netvalueperformancehis as a join mf_fundarchives as b on a.innercode = b.innercode and b.fundtype ='Bond Type' where a.annualizedrrsincestart > 20;

cn: 近三年我国各省市的企业收入和工商税收分别是多少钱
en: What is the income and commercial tax of enterprises in each province and city of China in the past three years?
sql: select enterpriseincome, commercialtax from ed_financialbalance  where strftime('%Y', enddate) > strftime('%Y', DATE('now', '-3 year'));

cn: 600743的哪些配股大股东的应配股数超过2百万股
en: Which controlling shareholders of 600743 have an allotment amount exceeding 2 million shares?
sql: select shname from lc_largeshsubscription where secucode='600743' and oughtshares>2000000;

cn: 去年毛利率大于1的公司有多少个
en: How many companies had a gross profit margin greater than 1 last year?
sql: select count(*) from lc_mainoperincome where strftime('%Y', enddate) = strftime('%Y', DATE('now', '-1 year')) and grossprofit > 1;

cn: 去年，在其他存款性公司资产负债表中，哪些记录的国外净资产超过了500万，请累出时间，总资产和国外净资产金额
en: Last year, in the balance sheet of other deposit-taking financial institutions, which records had foreign net assets exceeding 5 million? Please list the time, total assets, and the amount of foreign net assets.
sql: select enddate, totalassets, foreignassets from ed_otherdepositorycorpbs where strftime('%Y', enddate) = strftime('%Y', DATE('now', '-1 year')) and foreignassets > 5000000;

cn: 去年第四季度单次回购股份总数量超过10万份的公司有哪些
en: Which companies had a total quantity of repurchased shares exceeding 100,000 in the fourth quarter of last year?
sql: select secucode, chinameabbr from lc_buyback where buybacksum > 100000 and strftime('%Y', advancedate) = strftime('%Y', DATE('now', '-1 year')) and round(strftime('%m',advancedate)/3.0 + 0.495) = 4;

cn: 列出2005年，金融机构信贷收支中，各项存款总额超过1千万时，单位存款、财政性存款、农业存款的记录
en: List the records of unit deposits, treasury deposits, and agricultural deposits in the financial institution's credit and debit balance sheet in 2005 where the total deposit amount exceeds 10 million.
sql: select corporatesavings, financedeposits, agriculturaldeposits from ed_chinafibalancesheetrmb where strftime('%Y', enddate)='2005' and totalloans >10000000;

cn: 请问2018年A股总股本超过50亿的公司数目，按公司所在省份分组统计
en: How many companies had a total share capital exceeding 5 billion in 2018 in the A-share market, grouped by the provinces where the companies are located?
sql: select a.state, count(*) from lc_stockarchives as a join lc_freefloat as b on a.companycode = b.companycode  where b.totalashare > 5000000000 and strftime('%Y', changedate)='2018' group by  a.state

cn: 汇总出不同基金类别各有多少产品的日回报率超过1%
en: What is the number of products in different fund categories that have a daily return rate exceeding 1%?
sql: select b.fundtype, count(*) from mf_netvalueperformancehis as a join mf_fundarchives as b on a.innercode = b.innercode where a.nvdailygrowthrate > 1 group by b.fundtype;

cn: 有哪些股票2021年分红实际派现超过20元每股
en: Which stocks had actual cash dividends of over 20 yuan per share in 2021?
sql: select chinameabbr from lc_dividend where strftime('%Y', dividendimplementdate)='2021' and actualcashdivirmb > 20;

cn: 从业经验大于10年，学历为硕士的基金经理有哪些？他们管理的基金规模有多大？
en: Which fund managers have more than 10 years of professional experience and a master's degree? What is the size of the funds they manage?
sql: select b.chinesename, b.totalfundnv from mf_personalinfo as a join mf_fmscaleanalysisn as b on a.personalcode = b.personalcode where a.experiencetime > 10 and a.education = 'Master's Degree';

cn: 让我搜一下"华安180ETF"最近一周的周增长率记录吧
en: Let me search for the weekly growth rate records of "Huaan 180 ETF" in the past week.
sql: select enddate, nvweeklygrowthrate from mf_netvalue where strftime('%d', enddate) > DATE('now', '-7 day') and secuabbr = 'Huaan 180 ETF';

cn: 列出已流通股数超过1000万股的公司的公司名称、总经理和董事会秘书
en: List the company name, general manager, and board secretary of companies with a circulating share quantity exceeding 10 million shares.
sql: select a.chinameabbr, b.generalmanager, b.secretarybd from lc_sharesfloatingschedule as a join lc_stockarchives as b on a.companycode = b.companycode where a.accumarketableashares > 1000.

cn: 601996历史回购股份总数量超过10万的情况有哪些，列出回购日期和回购总数量
en: What are the situations in which the total quantity of repurchased shares by 601996 exceeds 100000? List the repurchase dates and the total quantity of repurchases.
sql: select advancedate, buybacksum from lc_buyback where buybacksum > 100000 and secucode = '601996';

cn: 研发人员比例超过10%的公司
en: Companies with a research and development personnel ratio exceeding 10%
sql: select chinameabbr from lc_intassetsdetail where rdstaffnumratio > 10;

cn: 哪些大股东的实配和应配股数都超过50万
en: Which major shareholders have both actual and allotted shares exceeding 500000?
sql: select shname from lc_largeshsubscription where actualshares>500000 and oughtshares>500000;

cn: 相对上一期报告期户均持股比例变化大于20%的公司
en: Companies with a change in average holding proportion greater than 20% compared to the previous reporting period
sql: select chinameabbr from lc_shnumber where proportionchange>20;

cn: 听说有个别股票冻结数量占比超过0.3，列出这些股票名称和冻结涉及股数
en: I heard that there are individual stocks whose frozen quantity accounts for more than 0.3%, list the names of these stocks and the number of shares involved in the freeze.
sql: select secucode, involvedsum from lc_sharefp where pctoftotalshares > 0.3;

cn: 展示2021年以来各股票最低和最高收盘价
en: Display the minimum and maximum closing prices of each stock since 2021.
sql: select chinameabbr, min(closeprice), max(closeprice) from qt_dailyquote where strftime('%Y', tradingday)>='2021' group by chinameabbr;

cn: 这三年来，北京的国内生产总值是多少哇
en: What is the gross domestic product of Beijing in the past three years?
sql: select gdp from ed_grossdomesticproduct where province='Beijing' and strftime('%Y', enddate) > strftime('%Y', DATE('now', '-3 year'));

cn: 2020年，哪些股东的持股金额在1千万以上，列出这些股东名称
en: In 2020, which shareholders have a shareholding amount of more than 10 million, list the names of these shareholders.
sql: select shname from lc_relatedsh where shinvestsum > 10000000 and strftime('%Y', enddate)='2020';

cn: 我想知道送股比例超过0.5的上市公司有几个
en: I want to know how many listed companies have a bonus share ratio exceeding 0.5.

cn: 证券从业经历年限超过10年且在任基金数目超过2只的基金经理人数，按基金类别分组展示
en: The number of fund managers whose securities industry experience exceeds 10 years and number of funds in position exceeds 2, grouped by fund category.
sql: select a.fundtypename, count(*) from mf_fmretscaleanalysis as a join mf_personalinfo as b on a.personalcode = b.personalcode where a.numberoffunds > 2 and b.experiencetime > 10 group by a.fundtypename

cn: hello，小爱，哪些债券型基金的一年回报率在20%以上
en: Hello Xiao Ai, which bond funds have a one-year return rate of over 20%?

cn: 哪些基金经理的本月以来基金基准增长率大于0

cn: 哎呀最近央行降息啦，贷款新增不少，请展示下2000年来，我们每年按"月份"记录的贷款新增金额和同比增减率

cn: 浙江省已流通股数超过5000万股的公司有多少家
en: How many companies in Zhejiang province have a circulating share count exceeding 50 million shares?

sql: select b.chinameabbr from lc_intassetsdetail as a join lc_stockarchives as b on a.companycode=b.companycode where b.state='Zhejiang Province' and strftime('%Y', enddate)>'2018' order by rdinputratio desc limit 10

sql: select a.education, count(*) from mf_personalinfo as a join mf_fmscaleanalysisn as b on a.personalcode = b.personalcode where b.totalfundnv > 100 group by a.education;

cn: 同学你好！前年开始，股东投资总额超过1千万的股东名称有哪些，列出股东、股票代码和股东投资总额
en: Hello classmate! Since two years ago, what are the names of shareholders whose total investment in shares exceeded 10 million? List the shareholders, stock codes, and their total investment in shares.
sql: select shname, secucode, shinvestsum from lc_relatedsh where shinvestsum > 10000000 and strftime('%Y', enddate) = strftime('%Y', DATE('now', '-2 year'));

cn: 列出户均持股占比小于10%的公司
en: List the companies with an average shareholding proportion less than 10%.
sql: select chinameabbr from lc_shnumber where holdproportionpaccount<10;

cn: 列出一个月基金基准增速为负的基金和基金类型 谢谢啊
en: List the funds with negative benchmark growth rate in one month and their fund types. Thank you.
sql: select b.secuabbr, b.type from mf_benchmarkgrowthrate as a join mf_fundarchives as b on a.innercode=b.innercode where a.monthlybenchgr<0.

cn: 你好，基金经理管理基金的年化阿尔法超过0.5的有多少位，按基金经理最高学历分组展示
en: Hello, how many fund managers have an annualized alpha coefficient greater than 0.5, grouped by the highest education level of the fund manager?
sql: select b.education, count(*) from mf_fmperfanalysis as a join mf_personalinfo as b on a.personalcode = b.personalcode where a.annalphacoef > 0.5 group by b.education

cn: 找出一个月基金基准增速高于8%的基金及基金管理人
en: Find the funds and fund managers with a monthly benchmark growth rate higher than 8%.
sql: select b.secuabbr, b.investadvisorname from mf_benchmarkgrowthrate as a join mf_fundarchives as b on a.innercode = b.innercode where a.monthlybenchgr > 8;

cn: 麻烦帮我看下000948最近三年的股东及股东持股数目
en: Could you please help me check the shareholders and the number of shares held by shareholders for 000948 in the past three years?
sql: select shname, holdingsum from lc_relatedsh where secucode ='000948' and strftime('%Y', enddate) > strftime('%Y', DATE('now', '-3 year'));

cn: 哪些基金管理人的注册资本小于10亿
en: Which fund managers have registered capital less than 1 billion?
sql: select investadvisorabbrname from mf_investadvisoroutline where regcapital < 1000000000;

cn: 本日基金基准增速大于0的基金由高到低的排名
en: Ranking of funds with positive benchmark growth rate from high to low today
sql: select secuabbr, dailybenchgr from mf_benchmarkgrowthrate where dailybenchgr > 0 order by dailybenchgr desc;

cn: 显示指标周期为"一年"的基金收益为负的基金数目，按基金运作形式分组展示
en: The number of funds with negative returns in the "One Year" index period, displayed and grouped by fund operating form.
sql: select b.type, count(*) from mf_fundreturnrank as a join mf_fundarchives as b on a.innercode = b.innercode where a.indexcycle = 'One Year' and a.fundreturn < 0 group by b.type

cn: 帮我找找数据，新天然气的累计占冻结质押方持股数占比超过0.8的冻结质押股东名称及冻结质押股数
en: Help me find the data on the names of frozen pledged shareholders and the number of frozen pledged shares where the cumulative proportion of New Natural Gas to frozen pledged shareholder's holding exceeds 0.8.
sql: select fpshname, accufpshares from lc_sharefpsta where chinameabbr = 'New Natural Gas' and accupctofpled > 0.8

cn: 你好，列出本周以来基金基准增速为负的基金由低到高的排名，还有增长率分别是多少
en: Hello, list the ranked funds with negative benchmark growth rate in ascending order since this week, and what are their growth rates respectively?
sql: select secuabbr, benchgrforthisweek from mf_benchmarkgrowthrate where benchgrforthisweek<0 order by benchgrforthisweek;

cn: 列出基金类别为"债券型"，且同类基金收益率均值大于0的基金名称
en: List the names of funds with a fund category of "Bond" and an average return greater than 0.
sql: select a.secuabbr from mf_fundreturnrank as a join mf_fundarchives as b on a.innercode = b.innercode where b.fundtype = 'Bond' and a.fundreturnmean > 0

cn: 帮我找找数据，给出户均持股数季度增速低于5%的公司
en: Help me find the data for companies with a quarterly growth rate of average shareholding per household below 5%.
sql: select chinameabbr from lc_shnumber where avgholdsumgrquarter<5;

cn: 哪些股东2020年的持股数量在1千万以上，列出这些股东名称
en: Which shareholders had a holding quantity of over 10 million in the year 2020? List the names of these shareholders.
sql: select shname from lc_relatedsh where holdingsum > 10000000 and strftime('%Y', enddate)='2020';

cn: 查找一下指标周期为"今年以来"的基金收益率小于0的基金名称
en: Find the names of funds with a return rate less than 0 for the index cycle "Year-to-date".
sql: select secuabbr from mf_fundreturnrank where indexcycle = 'Year-to-date' and fundreturn < 0

cn: 基金代码以16开头的，基金收益率大于0的基金有多少只
en: How many funds with a fund code starting with 16 have a fund return greater than 0?
sql: select count(*) from mf_fundreturnrank where secucode like '16%' and fundreturn > 0

cn: 筛选出管理股票型基金总规模超过200亿的所有基金经理名称
en: Filter out the names of all fund managers whose total assets under management in equity funds exceed 20 billion.
sql: select chinesename from mf_fmscaleanalysisn where equityfundnv > 200;

cn: 哪些王姓基金经理的从业时间超过10
en: Which fund managers with the surname Wang have more than 10 years of work experience?
sql: select chinesename from mf_personalinfo where chinesename like 'Wang%' and experiencetime > 10;

cn: 2017年后哪个行业ipo公司最多
en: Which industry has had the most IPO companies after 2017?
sql: select csrcindustryname from lc_ipodeclaration where strftime('%Y', enddate)>'2017' group by csrcindustryname order by count(*) desc limit 1;

cn: 展示总股本超过100亿上市公司的公司名称、所属一级行业
en: Display the company name and its primary industry of listed companies with a total share capital exceeding 10 billion.
sql: select b.chinameabbr, a.firstindustryname from lc_exgindustry as a join lc_sharestru as b on a.companycode = b.companycode where b.totalshares > 10000000000

cn: 找一下数据。在其他存款性公司资产负债表中，总资产金额超过5千万，而总负债金额不足5千万的记录是哪些，展示一下时间、总资产金额和总负债金额
en: Find the data. Which records in the balance sheet of other depositary financial institutions have total assets exceeding 50 million, but total liabilities less than 50 million? Display the time, total assets amount, and total liabilities amount.
sql: select enddate, totalassets, totalliabilities from ed_otherdepositorycorpbs where totalliabilities < 5000000 and totalassets > 50000000;

cn: 找到广东省A股总股本超过1亿的公司名称
en: Find the names of companies in Guangdong province with a total share capital exceeding 100 million.
sql: select b.chinameabbr from lc_stockarchives as a join lc_freefloat as b on a.companycode = b.companycode where a.state = 'Guangdong Province' and b.totalashare > 100000000

cn: 列出设立以来年化回报率超过30%的基金名称和代码
en: List the names and codes of funds with an annualized return rate exceeding 30% since establishment.
sql: select secucode, secuabbr from mf_netvalueperformancehis where annualizedrrsincestart > 30;

cn: 本日基金基准增长率大于0的基金由高到低的排名 感谢
en: Ranking of funds with benchmark growth rate greater than 0 from high to low today. Thank you.
sql: select secuabbr from mf_benchmarkgrowthrate where dailybenchgr>0 order by dailybenchgr desc

cn: 历史上主营业务利润超过1亿元的公司有哪些，列出公司代码和主营业务利润
en: Which companies in history have a main operating profit exceeding 100 million yuan? List the company codes and main operating profits.
sql: select secucode, mainoperprofit from lc_mainoperincome where mainoperprofit > 100000000;

cn: 你知道这5年来，全国各省市第一二三产业的gdp吗 感谢
en: Do you know the GDP of the primary, secondary, and tertiary industries in various provinces and cities nationwide over the past 5 years? Thank you.
sql: select enddate, province, primaryindustrygdp, secondindustrygdp, thirdindustrygdp from ed_grossdomesticproduct where strftime('%Y', enddate) > strftime('%Y', DATE('now', '-5 year'));

cn: 帮我列出2000年以前，我国出口同比增长，而进口同比减少的数据，列出进口金额和出口金额
en: Help me list the data of export and import amounts before the year 2000, where the year-on-year growth of our country's exports is positive while the year-on-year growth of imports is negative. List the import amount and export amount.
sql: select imvalueofgoods, exvalueofgoods from ed_exportimport where gyoyofexvaluegoods > 0 and gyoyofimvaluegoods < 0 and strftime('%Y', enddate)='2000';

cn: siri, 麻烦帮我统计一下不同基金运作方式各有几只基金产品一年回报率超过20%
en: Siri, could you please help me calculate the number of funds that have a yearly return rate exceeding 20% for each different operating form?
sql: select b.type, count(*) from mf_netvalueperformancehis as a join mf_fundarchives as b on a.innercode = b.innercode where a.rrinsingleyear > 20 group by b.type;

cn: 请问发生过募集金额超过100亿的股票配售记录吗？总共有几次
en: Has there been any stock placement records with fundraising amount exceeding 10 billion? How many times in total?
sql: select count(*) from lc_ashareplacement where plaproceeds > 10000000000;

cn: 2018年后保荐人是广发证券的公司的投入占比
en: The proportion of investment from companies with Guangfa Securities as the sponsor after 2018.
sql: select b.totalrdinput from lc_ipodeclaration as a join lc_intassetsdetail as b on a.companycode=b.companycode where strftime('%Y', a.enddate)>'2018' and a.sponsorname='Guangfa Securities';

cn: 列出2019年以前，主营业务收入同比为负数的公司代码 感谢
en: List the company codes with negative year-on-year main operating income before 2019. Thank you.
sql: select secucode from lc_mainoperincome where mainincomegrowrateyoy < 0 and strftime('%Y', enddate)<'2019';

cn: 2000年至今，北京市"期末累计"社会消费品零售总金额是多少
en: The total amount of "year-end cumulative" retail sales of consumer goods in Beijing from 2000 to the present is how much?
sql: select retailvalueofscgoods from ed_retailvalueofscgoods where province ='Beijing' and reportperiod ='year-end cumulative' and strftime('%Y', enddate)>='2000';

cn: 基金类型为股票型的产品中，哪些一周回报率大于5%
en: Which stocks have a weekly return rate greater than 5% in funds of stock type?
sql: select b.secuabbr from mf_netvalueperformancehis as a join mf_fundarchives as b on a.innercode = b.innercode where b.fundtype = 'stock' and a.rrinsingleweek > 5;

cn: 从前年起，投资数量超过1千万的股东有哪些，列出股东名称、股票代码和投资数量
en: From two years ago, which shareholders have invested more than 10 million? List the shareholder name, stock code, and investment quantity.
sql: select shname, secucode, holdingsum from lc_relatedsh where holdingsum > 10000000 and strftime('%Y', enddate) >= strftime('%Y', DATE('now', '-2 year'));

cn: 2010年至今，有哪些基金获得过"中国证券报"设立的奖项
en: Which funds have won awards established by "China Securities Journal" since 2010?
sql: select fund from mf_awards where strftime('%Y', `year`) >=2010 and appraisalorg = 'China Securities Journal';

cn: 返回出让后持股比例超过0.5的公司名称及所属一级行业
en: What are the company names and corresponding primary industries of companies whose shareholding ratio after transfer is higher than 0.5?
sql: select a.chinameabbr, b.firstindustryname from lc_sharetransfer as a join lc_exgindustry as b on a.companycode = b.companycode where a.pctaftertran > 0.5

cn: 你知道"股票型"基金中设立以来年化收益率超过50%的有哪些 谢谢啊
en: Which funds in the "Stock Type" category have had an annualized rate of return exceeding 50% since their establishment? Thank you.
sql: select a.secuabbr from mf_netvalueperformancehis as a join mf_fundarchives as b on a.innercode = b.innercode and b.fundtype ='Stock Type' where a.annualizedrrsincestart > 50;

cn: 帮我找找数据，指数型基金中有哪些六个月基金基准增长率超过5%
en: Help me find the data. Which index funds have a benchmark growth rate of more than 5% for the past six months?
sql: select b.secuabbr from mf_benchmarkgrowthrate as a join mf_fundarchives as b on a.innercode=b.innercode where a.benchgrfor6month>5 and b.investmenttype='Index Type';

cn: 把那些设立以来亏了很多的基金代码找出来，列出设立以来收益率低于-30%的基金代码和名称
en: Find the codes of the funds that have incurred significant losses since their establishment, and list the codes and names of the funds with a yield lower than -30% since their establishment.
sql: select secucode, secuabbr from mf_netvalueperformancehis where rrsincestart < -30;

cn: 快速找一下数据。请列举出来，设立以来年化收益率超过30%的"混合型"基金的代码和名称
en: Find the data quickly. Please list the codes and names of "Mixed Type" funds that have an annualized rate of return exceeding 30% since inception.
sql: select a.secuabbr, a.secucode from mf_netvalueperformancehis as a join mf_fundarchives as b on a.innercode = b.innercode and b.fundtype ='Mixed Type' where a.annualizedrrsincestart > 30;

cn: 帮我统计下最近两年古井贡酒的派新金额和实派人民币金额 感谢
en: Please help me calculate the dividend payout amount and actual dividend amount of GujingGongjiu in the past two years. Thank you.
sql: select divibase, bonusshareratio, tranaddshareraio from lc_dividend where secucode ='000728' and strftime('%Y', dividendimplementdate) > strftime('%Y', DATE('now', '-2 year'));

cn: 我想知道一个月回报在5%以上的基金有哪些？并展示它们的日回报率，一周回报率情况
en: I want to know which funds have a monthly return of more than 5%? And show their daily return rate and weekly return rate.
sql: select secuabbr, nvdailygrowthrate, rrinsingleweek from mf_netvalueperformancehis where rrinsinglemonth > 5;

cn: 帮我查一下到任日期在2021年以后的基金经理所管理的基金名称及基金风险等级
en: Please help me check the names of the funds managed by fund managers with a tenure starting in 2021 and their respective risk levels.
sql: select b.secuabbr, b.risklevel from mf_fundmanagernew as a join mf_fundrisklevel as b on a.innercode = b.innercode where strftime('%Y', a.accessiondate)>'2021'

cn: 嘿，查下五年基金基准增长率超过20%的基金、经理和投资投资目标
en: Hey, check the funds, managers, and investment targets with a benchmark growth rate exceeding 20% in the past five years.
sql: select b.secuabbr, b.manager, b.investtarget from mf_benchmarkgrowthrate as a join mf_fundarchives as b on a.innercode=b.innercode where a.benchgrfor5year>20;

cn: 去年主营业务收入超过1亿元的公司有几个
en: How many companies had a main operating income of over 100 million yuan last year?
sql: select count(*) from lc_mainoperincome where strftime('%Y', enddate) = strftime('%Y', DATE('now', '-1 year')) and mainoperincome > 100000000;

cn: 本次新增可售A股股数超过100万股的公司有多少家，按一级行业分组展示
en: How many companies have added over 1 million shares of tradable A-shares this time, grouped by first-level industry?

cn: 列出山煤国际2018年至今每天的开盘价和收盘价

en: Starting from two years ago, which shareholders had investment amounts exceeding 10 million RMB? List the names of shareholders, stock codes, and investment amounts.
sql: select shname, secucode, shinvestsum from lc_relatedsh where shinvestsum > 10000000 and strftime('%Y', enddate) = strftime('%Y', DATE('now', '-2 year'));

en: The number of funds with positive average returns in the "since inception" period, grouped by fund category, is shown.

cn: 基金经理从业年限小于2年且任职期间基金增长率为正的有哪些？
en: What are the funds managed by fund managers with less than 2 years of experience and positive fund growth rate during their tenure?
sql: select a.name from mf_fundmanagernew as a join mf_personalinfo as b on a.personalcode = b.personalcode where a.performance > 0 and b.experiencetime < 2

cn: 越剑智能初期持股数超过1000万的高管有哪些？
en: Which executives of Yuejian Intelligent have initial shareholding amounts exceeding 10 million?
sql: select leadername from lc_executivesholdings where chinameabbr = 'Yuejian Intelligent' and shareamountbeginning > 10000000

cn: 同学你好！任职期间基金增长率为负的基金经理有多少位？
en: Hello classmate! How many fund managers have a negative growth rate during their tenure?
sql: select count(*) from mf_fundmanagernew where performance < 0

cn: 快速找一下数据。筛选已流通A股占A股总数比例超过20%的公司的公司名称、法人
en: Quickly find the data. Select the company name and legal representative of companies in circulation with the proportion of A-shares exceeding 20% of the total A-shares.
sql: select a.chinameabbr, b.legalrepr from lc_sharesfloatingschedule as a join lc_stockarchives as b on a.companycode = b.companycode where a.proportion2 > 20

cn: 快速找一下数据。2018年后每个股东的最大配股数
en: Find the data quickly. What is the maximum allotment size for each shareholder after 2018?
sql: select shname, max(actualshares) from lc_largeshsubscription where strftime('%Y', initialinfopubldate)>'2018' group by shname;

cn: 已流通A股占A股总数比例超过60%的公司有多少家，按一级行业分组展示
en: How many companies that have a proportion of circulating A-shares exceeding 60% are there, grouped by primary industry?
sql: select b.firstindustryname, count(*) from lc_sharesfloatingschedule as a join lc_exgindustry as b on a.companycode = b.companycode where a.proportion2 > 60 group by b.firstindustryname

cn: 找一下数据。上一年配售股份超过1万分的投资者有哪些
en: Find the data. Which investors had an acquisition sum of over 10,000 shares in the previous year?
sql: select aquirername from lc_legaldistribution where aquiredsum > 10000 and strftime('%Y', infopubldate) = strftime('%Y', DATE('now', '-1 year'));

cn: 去年配售股份超过1万份的投资者有多少
en: How many investors acquired more than 10,000 shares in last year's public offering?
sql: select count(*) from lc_legaldistribution where aquiredsum > 10000 and strftime('%Y', infopubldate) = strftime('%Y', DATE('now', '-1 year'));

cn: 近两年单次回购股份总分数超过10万份的公司有哪些，列出公司名称和代码
en: Which companies have had a total share repurchase volume exceeding 100,000 shares in the past two years? Please list the company names and codes.
sql: select secucode, chinameabbr from lc_buyback where buybacksum > 100000 and strftime('%Y', advancedate) > strftime('%Y', DATE('now', '-2 year'));

cn: 那2010年以前，我们社会消费品销售总额有记录吗，有的话展示一下上海市每年的"年度"总金额
en: Did we have records of the total sales of consumer goods before 2010? If so, please display the annual total amount in Shanghai city.
sql: select enddate, retailvalueofscgoods from ed_retailvalueofscgoods where province = 'Shanghai' and reportperiod = 'annual' and strftime('%Y', enddate)<'2010';

cn: 帮我找一下数据！最近5年发生过多少次股票增发呀
en: Please help me find the data! How many times has there been a stock issuance in the last 5 years?
sql: select count(*) from lc_ashareseasonednewissue where strftime('%Y', advancedate) > strftime('%Y', DATE('now', '-5 year'));

cn: 未流通A股股数超过2亿的公司有多少家，按公司所在省份分组
en: How many companies have more than 200 million shares of non-listed A-shares, grouped by the province where the company is located?
sql: select a.state, count(*) from lc_stockarchives as a join lc_sharestru as b on a.companycode = b.companycode where b.nonlistedshares > 200000000 group by a.state

cn: 从业经验小于5年的基金经理平均管理了多少价值的基金
en: What is the average value of funds managed by fund managers with less than 5 years of work experience?
sql: select avg(b.totalfundnv) from mf_personalinfo as a join mf_fmscaleanalysisn as b on a.personalcode = b.personalcode where a.experiencetime < 5;

cn: 基金经理管理基金的年化夏普比率超过2，基金经理人数超过20的国籍有哪些？
en: What are the nationalities of fund managers whose annualized Sharpe ratio exceeds 2 and the number of fund managers exceeds 20?
sql: select b.nationality from mf_fmperfanalysis as a join mf_personalinfo as b on a.personalcode = b.personalcode where a.annsharper > 2 group by b.nationality having count(*) > 20

cn: 2021年A股总股本超过100亿的公司共计几家？
en: How many companies in the A-share market had a total capitalization exceeding 10 billion in 2021?
sql: select count(*) from lc_freefloat where totalashare > 10000000000 and strftime('%Y', changedate)='2021'

cn: 帮我看一下"顾瑜"去年持有的股票中，哪些股票的投资金额超过了1百万
en: Can you please tell me which stocks in "Gu Yu"'s holdings last year had an investment amount exceeding 1 million?
sql: select secucode from lc_relatedsh where shname='Gu Yu' and shinvestsum > 1000000 and strftime('%Y', enddate) = strftime('%Y', DATE('now', '-1 year'));

cn: 展示一下数据，1990年以后出生的基金经理有吗？
en: Can you show the data of fund managers born after 1990?
sql: select chinesename from mf_personalinfo where strftime('%Y', birthdate) > '1990';

cn: 最近两年，有哪些股票被冻结质押过，列出股票代码
en: Which stocks have been frozen pledged in the past two years? Provide a list of stock codes.
sql: select secucode from lc_sharefp where strftime('%Y', enddate) > strftime('%Y', DATE('now', '-2 year'));

cn: 帮忙列出在其他存款性公司资产负债表中，当总资产金额超过3千万时，对政府债权和对中央银行债权的金额分别是多大，并用时间区分
en: Help list the amounts of claims on government and claims on central bank in the balance sheet of other depository corporations when the total assets amount exceeds 30 million, and differentiate them by time.
sql: select enddate, claimsongovernment, claimsoncentralbank from ed_otherdepositorycorpbs where totalassets > 30000000;

cn: 管理债券型基金数量高于3个的基金经理有谁
en: Who are the fund managers who manage more than 3 bond funds?
sql: select chinesename from mf_fmscaleanalysisn where bondfundn>3;

cn: 你好啊，能给我查一下160416这只基金最近2年的单位基金净值周增长率吗
en: Hello, could you please show me the weekly growth rate of NAV for fund 160416 in the past 2 years?
sql: select enddate, nvweeklygrowthrate from mf_netvalue where strftime('%Y', enddate) > strftime('%Y', DATE('now', '-2 year')) and secucode ='160416';

cn: 列出六个月基金基准增长率为正的基金、经理和具体值
en: List the funds, managers, and specific values whose benchmark growth rate for six months is positive.
sql: select b.secuabbr, b.manager, a.benchgrfor6month from mf_benchmarkgrowthrate as a join mf_fundarchives as b on a.innercode=b.innercode where a.benchgrfor6month>0;

cn: 主营业务收入超过1000亿元的公司都分布在哪些省份 谢谢啊
en: Which provinces do companies with main operating income exceeding 100 billion yuan distribute in? Thank you.
sql: select b.state from lc_mainoperincome as a join lc_stockarchives as b on a.companycode = b.companycode where a.mainoperincome > 100000000000;

cn: 基金净值增长率小于0.1的基金经理名称及学历
en: The names and educational background of fund managers whose fund growth rate is less than 0.1.
sql: select a.name, b.education from mf_fundmanagernew as a join mf_personalinfo as b on a.personalcode = b.personalcode where a.performance < 0.1

cn: 方便查一下瑞茂通的股权冻结质押中，冻结数量超过1百万的股东名称吗
en: Can you conveniently check the names of shareholders in Rui Maotong with a frozen equity pledge quantity exceeding 1 million?
sql: select fpshname from lc_sharefp where chinameabbr = 'RuiMaotong' and involvedsum > 1000000;

cn: 你好，王总来视察了，帮忙提取出北京市近五年的企业增速收入超过5时，企业收入和企业所得税的记录
en: Hello, when extracting the records of enterprise income and corporate income tax for the past five years in Beijing, where the enterprise income growth rate exceeds 5, please assist.
sql: select enterpriseincome, enterpriseincometax from ed_financialbalance where genterpriseincome > 5 and province ='Beijing' and strftime('%Y', enddate) > strftime('%Y', DATE('now', '-5 year'));

cn: 基金经理管理基金的年化阿尔法超过0.5的有多少位，按基金经理学历分组展示
en: How many fund managers have an annualized alpha exceeding 0.5, grouped by fund manager education?
sql: select b.education, count(*) from mf_fmperfanalysis as a join mf_personalinfo as b on a.personalcode = b.personalcode where a.annalphacoef > 0.5 group by b.education

cn: 我想看看去年，国内生产总值同比超过0.5的省份名单
en: I would like to see the list of provinces whose year-on-year gross domestic product exceeded 0.5% last year.
sql: select province from ed_grossdomesticproduct where strftime('%Y', enddate) = strftime('%Y', DATE('now', '-1 year')) and gdpgrowthyoy > 0.5;

cn: 找到所有管理了超过5支股票型产品的基金经理，并展示相应的基金数量和总规模 谢谢
en: Find all fund managers who manage more than 5 equity funds and display the corresponding fund count and total scale. Thank you.
sql: select chinesename, equityfundn, equityfundnv from mf_fmscaleanalysisn where equityfundn > 5;

cn: 统计一下科思股份有多少个交易日成交总金额超1亿元
en: How many trading days of Kesi shares have a total turnover value exceeding 100 million yuan?
sql: select count(tradingday) from qt_dailyquote where chinameabbr = 'Kesi shares' and turnovervalue > 100000000;

cn: 深科技最近三年效益还行，它分红股本基数和派现金额是多少啊
en: How much is the dividend base and cash dividend amount of Shenzhen Technology in the past three years?
sql: select divibase, cashdivirmb from lc_dividend where chinameabbr='Shenzhen Technology' and strftime('%Y', dividendimplementdate) > strftime('%Y', DATE('now', '-3 year'));

cn: 快速找一下数据。2000年以来，人民币新增金额超过15万的记录有哪些，请找出按照"期末累计"记录的时间，和贷款新增金额字段
en: Quickly find the data. What are the records of RMB incremental amounts exceeding 150,000 since 2000? Please find the time recorded as "end of period cumulative" and the field of loan incremental amounts.
sql: select enddate, subjectsum from ed_newincreasingloan where reportperiod='End of Period Cumulative' and subjectsum > 150000 and strftime('%Y', enddate) >= '2000';

cn: hello,帮我查一下去年送股比例超过0.5的上市公司代码
en: Hello, please help me check the codes of the listed companies that had a bonus share ratio exceeding 0.5 last year.
sql: select secucode from lc_dividend where bonusshareratio > 0.5 and strftime('%Y', dividendimplementdate) = strftime('%Y', DATE('now', '-1 year'));

cn: 有LOF基金本月以来基金基准增长率为正吗
en: Is there a positive benchmark growth rate for LOF funds this month?
sql: select b.secuabbr from mf_benchmarkgrowthrate as a join mf_fundarchives as b on a.innercode=b.innercode where b.type='LOF' and a.benchgrforthismonth>0;

cn: 这三年来，我国出口金额超过4000万，进口金额低于2000万的出口金额和进口金额 感谢
en: In the past three years, the export amount of our country has exceeded 40 million, while the import amount is less than 20 million. Thank you.
sql: select imvalueofgoods , exvalueofgoods from ed_exportimport  where imvalueofgoods < 20 and exvalueofgoods > 40 and strftime('%Y', enddate) > strftime('%Y', DATE('now', '-3 year'));

cn: 福建省上市公司里有应配股数大于100万股的吗？
en: Are there any listed companies in Fujian Province with a subscription quantity greater than 1 million shares?
sql: select b.chinameabbr from lc_largeshsubscription as a join lc_stockarchives as b on a.companycode=b.companycode where b.state='Fujian Province' and a.oughtshares>1000000;

cn: 给咱们搜一下2005年以后，国内信贷和外币存款的数据 感谢
en: Please search for the data on domestic loans and foreign currency deposits after 2005. Thank you.
sql: select domesticloans, fcdeposits from ed_chinamoneyandbanking where strftime('%Y', enddate)>='2005';

cn: 古井贡酒历年派现金额超过5块的记录有哪些，展示股权登记日和派现金额 谢谢啊
en: What are the records in which Gujing Gongjiu's annual dividend amount exceeds 5 yuan? Display the equity registration date and dividend amount. Thank you.
sql: select rightregdate, cashdivirmb from lc_dividend where cashdivirmb > 5 and chinameabbr = 'Gujing Gongjiu';

cn: 基金经理学历为博士且任职天数超过200天的有哪些？
en: Which fund managers have a doctoral degree and have served for more than 200 days?
sql: select a.name from mf_fundmanagernew as a join mf_personalinfo as b on a.personalcode = b.personalcode where a.managementtime > 200 and b.education = 'Doctoral Degree'

cn: 显示指标周期为"六个月"的同类基金收益率均值为负的基金数目，按基金运作方式分组展示
en: The number of funds with negative average return in the same category with a display period of "six months", grouped by fund operation mode.
sql: select b.type, count(*) from mf_fundreturnrank as a join mf_fundarchives as b on a.innercode = b.innercode where a.indexcycle = 'six months' and a.fundreturnmean < 0 group by b.type

cn: 展示一下这两年我国货币和准货币的总记录，以及货币和准货币分别是多少
en: Display the total records of currency and quasimoney in China in the past two years, and the respective amounts of currency and quasimoney.
sql: select moneyandquasimoney, money1, quasimoney from ed_chinamoneyandbanking where strftime('%Y', enddate) > strftime('%Y', DATE('now', '-2 year'));

cn: siri, 2021年第一季度哪些基金期末资产净值超过百亿
en: Siri, in the first quarter of 2021, which funds have year-end net asset values exceeding 10 billion?
sql: select secuabbr from mf_mainfinancialindexq where strftime('%Y', enddate)='2021' and round(strftime('%m', enddate)/3.0 + 0.495) = 1 and netassetsvalue > 10000000000

cn: 显示2019年流通A股股本超过100亿的公司数目，按公司所在二级行业分组统计
en: Display the number of companies with circulating A-share equity exceeding 10 billion in 2019, grouped by the second-level industry in which the companies are located.
sql: select a.secondindustryname, count(*) from lc_exgindustry as a join lc_freefloat as b on a.companycode = b.companycode where b.afloats > 10000000000 and strftime('%Y', changedate)='2019' group by a.secondindustryname

cn: 平均基金规模大于500亿元的基金经理国籍分布情况 谢谢啊
en: What is the distribution of fund manager nationality for funds with an average fund size larger than 50 billion RMB? Thank you.
sql: select b.nationality, count(*) from mf_fmretscaleanalysis as a join mf_personalinfo as b on a.personalcode = b.personalcode where a.avgaum > 500 group by b.nationality

cn: 帮李处长查一下咱们1995年以前货币和准货币总金额是多少，货币、准货币金额分别是多少
en: Help Director Li find out the total amount of currency and quasi-money before 1995, and the respective amounts of currency and quasi-money.
sql: select moneyandquasimoney, money1, quasimoney from ed_chinamoneyandbanking where strftime('%Y', enddate)<'1995';

cn: 请问有哪些公司和成交日对应成交总额超过10亿
en: Which companies and corresponding trade dates have a total turnover exceeding 1 billion?
sql: select chinameabbr, tradingday from qt_dailyquote where turnovervalue > 1000000000;

cn: 帮我查一下这些数据。请问，证券从业经历超过10年的基金经理的同类经理收益率排名情况
en: Please help me check this data. What is the ranking of the same category manager's return rate for fund managers with more than 10 years of experience in the securities industry?
sql: select a.returntyperank from mf_fmretandscalerank as a join mf_personalinfo as b on a.personalcode = b.personalcode where b.experiencetime > 10

cn: 哥，嘿，小李，能帮我查一下我国国外净资产超过1百万元的记录情况吗，给出日期和国外净资产金额的字段
en: Hey, Xiaoli, can you help me check the records of China's overseas net assets exceeding 1 million yuan? Please provide the fields of the date and the amount of overseas net assets.
sql: select enddate, netabroadassets from ed_chinamoneyandbanking where netabroadassets > 1000000;

cn: 请搜索一下，这些年来，我们总资产超过1千万时，外汇金额、货币黄金金额和其他国外资产的数据，
en: Please search for the data on the amount of foreign exchange, amount of currency gold, and other foreign assets when our total assets exceed 10 million in recent years.
sql: select forex, moneyandgold, otherforeignassets from ed_moneyauthoritybs where totalassets > 10;

cn: 这两年，我国金融机构信贷收支中，财政借款和财政性存款总额是多少
en: What is the total amount of fiscal loans and fiscal deposits in the credit and debit of financial institutions in China in the past two years?
sql: select loantogov, financedeposits from ed_chinafibalancesheetrmb where strftime('%Y', enddate) > strftime('%Y', DATE('now', '-2 year'));

cn: 展示一下数据，返回离职日期在2020年以前的基金经理所管理的基金名称及基金风险等级
en: Show the data, return the fund names and fund risk levels managed by fund managers whose resignation dates are before 2020.
sql: select b.secuabbr, b.risklevel from mf_fundmanagernew as a join mf_fundrisklevel as b on a.innercode = b.innercode where strftime('%Y', a.dimissiondate)<'2020'

cn: 李工想问能不能给他显示下前年，有没有按"月份"记录的贷款新增金额超过了10万，有的话，请提取一下时间和贷款金额和同比增减记录
en: Can Li Gong be shown if there were any "monthly" recorded loan amounts exceeding 100,000 in the previous year? If there were, please extract the time, loan amount, and year-on-year change records.
sql: select enddate, subjectsum, yoy from ed_newincreasingloan where reportperiod = 'monthly' and subjectsum > 100000 and strftime('%Y', enddate) = strftime('%Y', DATE('now', '-2 year'));

cn: 上海市流通股本超过1000万的公司有哪些？ 谢谢啊
en: Which companies in Shanghai have circulating shares exceeding 10 million? Thank you.
sql: select b.chinameabbr from lc_stockarchives as a join lc_sharestru as b on a.companycode = b.companycode where a.state = 'Shanghai' and b.afloats > 10000000

cn: 同学你好！按照基金类别分组统计各自有多少设立以来年化回报超过10%
en: Hello classmate! Group and count the number of funds in each category that have had an annualized return exceeding 10% since inception.
sql: select b.fundtype, count(*) from mf_netvalueperformancehis as a join mf_fundarchives as b on a.innercode = b.innercode where a.annualizedrrsincestart > 10 group by b.fundtype;

cn: 同学你好！本次新增可售A股股数不超过1000万股的公司有哪些
en: Hello classmates! Which companies have not added more than 10 million tradable A-shares in this round?
sql: select chinameabbr from lc_sharesfloatingschedule where newmarketableashares <= 1000'

cn: 我们总资产不足1千万的记录有哪些，主要列出时间、外汇金额、货币黄金和其他国外货币的记录 谢谢
en: What records do we have for total assets less than 10 million, specifically listing the records for time, forex amount, money and gold, and other foreign currencies? Thank you.
sql: select enddate, forex, moneyandgold, otherforeignassets from ed_moneyauthoritybs where totalassets < 10;

cn: 无限售条件流通A股股数超过100亿的公司有多少家，按公司所在一级行业分组
en: How many companies have more than 10 billion circulating shares of A-shares under unrestricted conditions, grouped by the primary industry in which the companies belong?
sql: select a.firstindustryname, count(*) from lc_exgindustry as a join lc_sharestru as b on a.companycode = b.companycode where b.nonrestrictedshares  > 10000000000 group by a.firstindustryname

cn: 我朋友想知道去年单次回购股份总金额达到1亿元的公司数量
en: My friend wants to know the number of companies that had a total amount of stock repurchases reaching 100 million yuan last year.
sql: select count(*) from lc_buyback where buybackmoney >= 100000000 and strftime('%Y', advancedate) = strftime('%Y', DATE('now', '-1 year'));

cn: siri, 统计一下出让前持股比例超过0.2的公司有多少家
en: Siri, please provide the number of companies that have a pre-transfer shareholding ratio exceeding 0.2.
sql: select count(*) from lc_sharetransfer where pctbeforetran > 0.2

cn: 查出已流通A股占A股总数比例超过50%有哪些？
en: What are the stocks with a proportion of circulating A shares exceeding 50% of the total A shares?
sql: select chinameabbr from lc_sharesfloatingschedule where proportion2 > 50

cn: 帮我找找数据，计算出有几个基金经理的管理总规模超过500亿
en: Help me find the data and calculate the number of fund managers whose total management scale exceeds 50 billion.
sql: select count(*) from mf_fmscaleanalysisn where totalfundnv > 500;

cn: 显示指标周期为"一年"的基金收益率为负的基金数目，按基金运作方式分组展示 感谢
en: What is the number of funds with negative fund returns in the "one-year" index cycle, grouped by fund operating mode? Thank you.
sql: select b.type, count(*) from mf_fundreturnrank as a join mf_fundarchives as b on a.innercode = b.innercode where a.indexcycle = 'one-year' and a.fundreturn < 0 group by b.type

cn: 展示一下最近三年，全国的"年度"社会消费品零售总金额，用时间区分
en: Display the total amount of retail sales of consumer goods in the "annual" social consumption in the whole country in the past three years, differentiated by time.
sql: select enddate, retailvalueofscgoods from ed_retailvalueofscgoods where reportarea ='National' and reportperiod ='Annual' and strftime('%Y', enddate) > strftime('%Y', DATE('now', '-3 year'));

cn: 给出各基金投资类型中基金今年以来基金基准增长率为负的个数
en: How many funds have a negative benchmark growth rate for the year in each fund investment type?
sql: select b.investmenttype, count(*) from mf_benchmarkgrowthrate as a join mf_fundarchives as b on a.innercode=b.innercode where a.benchgrforthisyear<0 group by b.investmenttype;

cn: 基金经理学历为"本科"且所管理的基金总规模超过100亿元的基金经理人数
en: The number of fund managers with a bachelor's degree and the total size of the funds they manage exceeds 10 billion yuan.
sql: select count(*) from mf_fmretscaleanalysis as a join mf_personalinfo as b on a.personalcode = b.personalcode where a.totalaum > 100 and b.education = 'Undergraduate'

cn: 统计出证券从业经验大于15年的基金经理管理基金规模平均值
en: Calculate the average fund size managed by fund managers with more than 15 years of securities industry experience.
sql: select avg(b.totalfundnv) from mf_personalinfo as a join mf_fmscaleanalysisn as b on a.personalcode = b.personalcode where a.experiencetime > 15;

cn: 显示指标周期为"一个月"的基金收益率为正的基金数目，按基金运作方式分组展示
en: What is the number of funds with positive returns in the "one-month" indicator period, displayed by fund operating form grouping?

en: Find the names of shareholders in Ruimaotong whose proportion of frozen shares exceeds 0.05% of the total share capital.
sql: select fpshname from lc_sharefp where chinameabbr = 'Ruimaotong' and pctoftotalshares > 0.05;

cn: 帮李老师查查，咱们最近两年的实收资本，国外净资产和国内信贷分别输多少
en: Help Teacher Li check how much our capital received, net foreign assets, and domestic loans have respectively lost in the last two years.
sql: select capitalreceived, netabroadassets, domesticloans from ed_chinamoneyandbanking where strftime('%Y', enddate) > strftime('%Y', DATE('now', '-2 year'));

cn: 展示注册资本超过100亿的大基金公司及对应的注册地，注册资本 感谢
en: Display the names, registered locations, and registered capitals of large fund companies with registered capital exceeding 10 billion. Thank you.
sql: select investadvisorabbrname, regaddr, regcapital from mf_investadvisoroutline where regcapital > 10000000000;

cn: 有旗下基金总数超过15个的基金经理吗
en: Are there any fund managers with more than 15 funds under their management?
sql: select chinesename from mf_fmscaleanalysisn where numberoffunds>15;

cn: 2015年以后，各地区成立基金公司数量分布
en: Distribution of the number of fund management companies established in each region after 2015.
sql: select region, count(*) from mf_investadvisoroutline where strftime('%Y', establishmentdate)>'2015' group by region;
